scope.decision_boundary: Package/hash coherence is distinct from semantic sufficiency. A draft-self occurrence proves only a constitutive, prospective, or declaration surface; it does not by itself prove an executed status, count, hash, author event, AI-use fact, Route state, source-passage relation, or external-method proposition.

applicable_rules: integrity Stage 4.5 Mode 2 verifies all registered claims
one evidence row is required per claim/source/anchor tuple
an actual session-held raw source passage is required for passage-level support
metadata, a URL, a locator, an artifact hash, and self-authored matrix prose are not substitutes for a source passage
compound-claim overall verdict equals the weakest relevant atomic component
irrelevant missing components must not be injected merely to force a conservative verdict
